why: NOTES-FROM-PLANNING.md entry 161. A friend's scan on which naming the correct calibre made the reading substantially worse: with 0.264 named, five of ten perfectly detected holes were called possibly two. It is a friend's target and is used here as a local fixture only: nothing from it is committed or published until there is a consent record. The tests that read this file run where the scan is present and skip with a clear message where it is not.
note: Ten shots, one per bull on bulls 1 to 10. Holes measure 0.301 in across the middle, 1.14 of the bullet.
